cards.text: Jeremiah the prophet gets a word from the LORD about the nations, and this one is about Egypt. It's about the army of Pharaoh Neco, king of Egypt, defeated at Carchemish on the Euphrates River in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah. Friend, when the LORD sends a word with your name on it, I'd sit down for that one.

cards.question: Pharaoh Neco's army was defeated at Carchemish. Who defeated it?

cards.text: Then the message drops us onto a battlefield with orders flying: shields up, harness the horses, helmets on, polish the spears, armor on, advance for battle! That is a whole CHECKLIST, friend, and somebody back there is holding a clipboard.

cards.question: After all those battle orders, the LORD says, "Why am I seeing this?" What is He seeing?

cards.text: They flee in haste without looking back, and terror is on every side. Not ONE of them looks back, friend. That's somebody leaving work at 5:00 on a Friday.

cards.question: In this battle, Egypt's fastest soldiers manage to get away.

cards.text: Then the message asks, "Who is this, rising like the Nile, like rivers whose waters churn?" That's the kind of rising I get when I forget a batch of dough on the counter. You turn around and it's EVERYWHERE.

cards.question: Who's rising like a river? ___ rises like the Nile, and its waters churn like rivers.
Egypt rising like the Nile comes with a boast. What does Egypt boast it will do?

answers.text: Cover the earth and destroy cities
Build a wall around its borders

cards.text: Then the orders start up again: "Advance, O horses! Race furiously, O chariots!" Not just race, friend, race FURIOUSLY, and the warriors are called to come forth too.

cards.question: Warriors are called to come forth, carrying shields and drawing bows. Where are they from?

cards.text: Here's the turn, friend. Egypt's been bragging, but that day belongs to the Lord GOD of Hosts, and the sword will devour until it is satisfied.

cards.question: That day belongs to the Lord GOD of Hosts. It is a day of ___ against His foes.
The sword will devour until it is quenched with blood. What will the Lord GOD of Hosts hold in the land of the north by the River Euphrates?

cards.text: Then the message speaks straight to Egypt, calling her the Virgin Daughter of Egypt, and tells her to go up to Gilead, a land east of the Jordan River, for balm. Friend, when they send you clear across the map for the ointment, that's not a paper cut.

cards.question: Egypt is told to go up to Gilead for balm. She tries many remedies, but for her there is no ___.
The nations hear about Egypt's shame.
Egypt's outcry fills the earth. Why?

answers.text: Her warriors stumble over each other and fall
Her cities are flooded by the Nile
Her king is carried off as a captive
